Entries.Original: During patrol missions, your objective is to map out the area to which you have been deployed.
You can see the percentage of the area you have mapped on this screen. Aim for 100%.
Press the X button to return.
Energy is consumed in accordance with the number of turns you spend in battle. When Energy reaches zero, HP will gradually decrease, so please be careful.
You can return to base at any time via the mePad button.\n(Your progress will not be lost.)
You can return to base at any time by opening the mePad menu via the Options button.\n(Your progress will not be lost.)
You have now mapped out 100% of this area.
"COMPLETE" will be displayed once you have mapped 100% of the area.
Return to the base at any time once the entire area has been mapped!
While an patrol mission is in progress, targets will appear in the field.
Proceed toward those targets and defeat them, preserving your energy as much as possible.
